title: The Book of 3 John Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 3 John — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
verses.decoded: The elder writes to dear Gaius, whom I love sincerely and truly.

verses.kjv: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
verses.decoded: Dear friend, I pray that you are successful and healthy, just as your soul is doing well.

verses.kjv: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
verses.decoded: I was very happy when the brothers and sisters told me about the genuine faith you live by.

verses.kjv: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
verses.decoded: Nothing makes me happier than hearing that those I have helped are living according to the truth.

verses.kjv: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
verses.decoded: Dear friend, you are faithful in everything you do for fellow believers and for strangers alike.

verses.kjv: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
verses.decoded: They have told the church about your generosity; if you help them on their way in a manner worthy of God, you will be doing right.

verses.kjv: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: They left for the sake of Jesus and accepted no financial help from non-believers.

verses.kjv: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
verses.decoded: So we should welcome them and partner with them in spreading the truth.

verses.kjv: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.decoded: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be the leader, refuses to welcome us.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
verses.decoded: If I visit, I will confront him about his actions—he speaks badly about us, refuses to welcome other believers, forbids those who want to, and even expels them from the church.

verses.kjv: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.decoded: Dear friend, don’t imitate what is wrong; instead, do what is right. Anyone who does good comes from God, but anyone who does evil does not truly know God.

verses.kjv: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
verses.decoded: Demetrius is well respected by everyone and by the truth itself. We also testify about him, and you know our testimony is reliable.

verses.kjv: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
verses.decoded: I have many things to tell you, but I won’t write them down with pen and ink.

verses.kjv: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
verses.decoded: But I hope to see you soon so we can talk in person.

verses.kjv: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
verses.decoded: Peace be with you. Our friends send their greetings. Please greet our friends personally by name.
